motion.content: CSS scroll-driven .reveal only (visible in pre-rendered HTML)
motion.illustrations: motion/react loops (robot demo, terminal, beams), all respect prefers-reduced-motion

must: Content must be readable in the pre-rendered HTML (no opacity-0 initial states on text)
Real product copy and real blindqa output only — no invented customers, logos or metrics
Every interactive control keyboard-reachable with a visible focus ring
avoid: Entrance animations driven by JS on text content
Brand icons from lucide (removed in 1.x) — use components/ui/github-icon

decisions.decision: Dark technical direction matching the social preview: navy background, blue primary, violet accent
decisions.source: user request: best-looking landing page from 21st components

decisions.decision: 21st components used: Hero Section Dark #19, Floating Header #8137, Safari #1241, Script Copy Button #1095 (as install tabs), Terminal #28360, bento grid 01 #9594, Animated Beam #919, Border Beam #1268, Accordion #31351, Minimal Footer #7264
Robot demo app keeps its own hard-coded palette (it depicts a different app); decorative glows use literal rgb values
